newsitem.title: USA: Sysco says well postured for growth in FY98.
newsitem.headline: Sysco says well postured for growth in FY98.

text.p: Sysco Corp said Wednesday it is well-postured for future growth for the coming year and beyond, and sales and earnings growth in its "fold-out" program at three centers is exceeding its expectations.
The company said its strong balance sheet, the breadth of its products and its customer service focus is what makes it "well-postured" for future growth.
Sysco's "fold-out" program refers to its plan of adding new distribution centers in poular markets.
Capital expenditures for building the new centers and for expanding and modernizing existing facilities, as well as purchases of fleet and equipment, was $211 million for the fiscal year.
It said its sales and earnings growth in the fold-out program is exceeding its expecations at centers in Connecticut, Florida and Wisconsin opened in 1995 and 1996.
Three additional new centers are in various stages of progress.
The company reported earnings per share for the quarter of $0.52 compared to $0.46, and earnings per share for the year of $1.71 compared to $1.52.
